import sys


def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()

    if not data:
        return

    iterator = iter(data)

    S = int(next(iterator))
    T = int(next(iterator))

    # Matriz de adjacência para consulta O(1)
    # S <= 1000, logo uma matriz (S+1) x (S+1) consome pouca memória
    adj = [[False] * (S + 1) for _ in range(S + 1)]

    for _ in range(T):
        u = int(next(iterator))
        v = int(next(iterator))
        adj[u][v] = True
        adj[v][u] = True

    P = int(next(iterator))
    valid_paths_count = 0

    for _ in range(P):
        N = int(next(iterator))
        path = [int(next(iterator)) for _ in range(N)]

        possible = True
        for i in range(N - 1):
            if not adj[path[i]][path[i + 1]]:
                possible = False
                break

        if possible:
            valid_paths_count += 1

    print(valid_paths_count)


if __name__ == "__main__":
